module.name: require-bdd-spec
module.description: ESLint rule that enforces sibling, source-reference, and named-export relationships for repository BDD documents without duplicating parsing or structural schema validation.

scenarios.name: should skip test source files
scenarios.given: a TypeScript source filename ending in .test.ts
scenarios.then: the rule does not require a sibling BDD document

scenarios.name: should report a missing sibling BDD document
scenarios.given: a non-test TypeScript source file without a sibling .bdd.json file
scenarios.then: the rule reports the expected sibling path

scenarios.name: should report an incorrect sourceFile reference
scenarios.given: a parsed sibling BDD document whose sourceFile differs from the linted workspace-relative path
scenarios.when: the Program visitor compares the paths
scenarios.then: the rule reports the expected source reference

scenarios.name: should report named-export parity differences
scenarios.given: a BDD module.exports list that differs from named exports in the Program AST
scenarios.when: the Program visitor compares both name sets
scenarios.then: the rule reports documented and source exports missing from either side

scenarios.name: should support declarations, destructuring defaults, types, and export specifiers
scenarios.given: a Program containing multiple TypeScript named-export forms including assignment patterns
scenarios.when: the rule collects named exports directly from the ESLint AST
scenarios.then: all exported identifiers and aliases participate in parity validation without source-text regular expressions

scenarios.name: should leave JSON Schema validation to the workspace validator
scenarios.given: a parseable sibling document whose structure does not expose relationship fields
scenarios.when: the published ESLint rule checks the document
scenarios.then: the rule does not reimplement schema fields that validate:bdd checks with Ajv

scenarios.name: should leave malformed JSON diagnostics to the workspace validator
scenarios.given: a sibling BDD document that cannot be parsed as JSON
scenarios.when: the published ESLint rule attempts to read relationship fields
scenarios.then: the rule skips relationship checks because validate:bdd owns parsing diagnostics
